review_candidates.title: Lamineur(euse) en préimprégné
review_candidates.description: Sommaire du poste Vous avez des doigts de fée et l'œil pour le détail ? Chez Avior, nous fabriquons des pièces en matériaux composites. Nous cherchons des personnes minutieuses pour draper nos pièces en matériau préimprégnée. Aucune expérience en composites ? Si vous avez travaillé de vos mains avec précision, nous vous formons. Principales Tâches Draper les plis de préimprégné sur les moules selon les fiches de drapage (séquence, orientation des fibres). Éliminer plis, bulles et corps étrangers à chaque couche ; faire les compactages sous vide. Préparer les moules (nettoyage, agent de démoulage) et réaliser l'ensachage sous vide. Remplir les documents de traçabilité : numéros de lot, temps hors congélateur, autocontrôles. Respecter les règles de la salle propre et les normes qualité [ex. AS9100]. Profil Recherché Profil recherché Expérience en lamination, composites, fibre de verre ou préimprégné : un atout. Ou une expérience en travail manuel de précision : pose de vinyle ou de film, couture industrielle, tapisserie, assemblage électronique, orthèses-prothèses, assemblage en usine. Capacité à lire un plan ou une instruction de travail. (Instructions en Français) Grande minutie, patience et respect rigoureux des procédures. Capacité à travailler debout et à porter gants et sarrau pendant tout le quart. Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent, Langue OBLIGATOIRE : Compréhension du français (parlé et lecture) pour comprendre les consignes de sécurité et la documentation technique. Le processus comprend un court test pratique d'environ 30 minutes , sans piège : nous voulons voir votre dextérité, pas vos connaissances. Présentation De La Structure Avior Produits Intégrés est une entreprise québécoise spécialisée dans la fabrication de structures aéronautiques légères et d’assemblages mécaniques complexes. Réparties dans quatre usines, nos équipes mettent leur expertise au service de grands acteurs de l’aérospatiale, notamment Bombardier, Boeing, Bell et Airbus. Notre mission : fournir des solutions manufacturières de haute qualité qui répondent aux exigences de précision, de fiabilité et de performance de l’industrie aéronautique. Nos activités combinent la transformation des métaux, les matériaux composites avancés, l’usinage et l’assemblage. L’innovation occupe une place centrale dans nos opérations, notamment grâce à la robotique et aux solutions développées par notre Centre d’excellence en automatisation. Derrière chaque pièce se trouvent des personnes passionnées qui contribuent chaque jour à notre réussite. Nous offrons des possibilités de carrière variées en production, en ingénierie, en qualité, en administration et dans plusieurs métiers techniques, dans un environnement qui valorise la collaboration, l’apprentissage et le développement professionnel. Avantages Plan d'épargne pour la retraite collectif (PERCO) Parking gratuit

High attention to detail and the ability to manage sensitive employee information with discretion. review_candidates.description: Role Overview The Engineer, Manufacturing Applications and Smart Factory develops, maintains, and supports digital manufacturing solutions, with primary responsibility for the Tulip MES platform and its applications at HSOT. The role translates manufacturing needs into secure, reliable, usable, and compliant applications and provides operational support throughout the application lifecycle. Working closely with Manufacturing, Operations Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, IT, and technology partners, the engineer will also help expand HSO’s smart-factory capabilities through workflow digitization, system and equipment integration, trusted manufacturing data, operational visibility, and scalable automation solutions. Duties and Responsibilities Discover, analyze, and prioritize manufacturing requirements with Production, Operations Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Warehouse, and Global IT stakeholders. Design, configure, test, document, deploy, and support Tulip MES applications and related digital manufacturing workflows for HSOT. Develop integrations and data flows between MES applications, approved equipment, devices, enterprise systems, and trusted data platforms, ensuring solutions remain supportable, secure, scalable, and compliant. Perform computer system validation activities for MES and manufacturing application changes, including risk-based assessment, traceability between requirements, configuration and testing, support for validation deliverables, and release approval readiness. Deploy and monitor applications, resolve incidents and recurring problems, and drive continuous improvement of usability, reliability, performance, adoption, and operational effectiveness. Maintain application, interface, device, configuration, validation, and support documentation in accordance with Global IT standard operating procedures, work instructions, and compliance expectations. Identify and evaluate smart-factory and digital-manufacturing use cases with Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain, including workflow digitization, production record digitization, traceability, visibility, shop-floor data acquisition, and contextualization. Develop reusable application components, integration patterns, and scalable approaches that can be industrialized after successful proof-of-concept activities. Contribute to manufacturing dashboards, alerts, and operational analytics where they support shop-floor visibility, exception management, and data-driven decision making. Help define the HSOT manufacturing applications and smart-factory roadmap, including opportunities to replace or retire obsolete applications and improve lifecycle management. Prepare design specifications and solution documentation for stakeholder review and present proposed solutions, changes, and impacts in relevant IT architecture, change, validation, and governance forums. Provide regular project, support, and risk updates to the supervisor and communicate clearly with manufacturing and business teams on priorities, releases, incidents, and improvement activities. Indicative focus: Approximately 50% application development and enhancement, 40% operational support and continuous improvement, and 10% documentation and validation. Requirements Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT manufacturing applications, MES, or digital manufacturing solutions in a regulated manufacturing environment. Proven experience as a Manufacturing Applications Engineer, MES Engineer, Smart Factory Engineer, or similar IT role supporting production and quality operations. Strong understanding of MES concepts, manufacturing application lifecycle, production traceability, electronic records, and system integration principles. Equipment connectivity & automated data collection (e.g MQTT, OPC-UA & API) OT-IT Collaboration Knowledge of application configuration, database concepts, APIs, interface troubleshooting, and low-code or no-code manufacturing application development; specific programming experience is an advantage. Hands-on knowledge of Tulip MES or comparable MES platforms; including MES and ERP integration scenarios. Schaumburg is an award-winning community located just 28 miles northwest of Chicago and is a haven of opportunity and growth. As a thriving hub of excellence, Schaumburg has it all. It’s a place where high-quality municipal services and economic development meet a myriad of cultural and recreational amenities. The current Finance Director is retiring after serving for 15 years in the position. Schaumburg is a top-tier, full-service municipality staffed with professional employees who are expected to think strategically, be accessible and responsive, and to embrace change with the ability to develop and achieve annual goals. The organization benefits from stable and consistent elected and administrative leadership. The Director of Finance is responsible for directing the Village’s financial operations in alignment with its mission, policies, and goals. This leader oversees and advances financial planning, budgeting, accounting, licensing, and water billing, while ensuring compliance, transparency, and responsible stewardship of public funds. The Director also serves as Treasurer for both Police and Fire public safety pension funds. The Finance Director will leverage a strong and talented team, modern financial systems, and established policies to support departments across the organization. As a trusted advisor to executive leadership, the Finance Director provides clear, actionable financial insight and builds confidence among internal and external stakeholders. The Director is appointed by the Village Manager. The Finance Department consists of 22 individuals, including an Assistant Director of Finance, Accounting Manager, and Financial Services Manager. Top Candidates Will Bring: Advanced knowledge – a thorough understanding of principles and practices of governmental accounting. Collaborative expertise – the talent to facilitate collaboration, integrating and solving problems to ensure both content and projects are meeting objectives and deadlines. Customer-centric – experience working with internal and external stakeholders and the ability to establish and maintain relationships with a variety of individuals and organizations. Dedicated Professionalism and Leadership – an individual who displays confidence, is honest, fair, and possesses integrity, who will be hard-working, creative and ethical and who leads by example in a highly transparent organization. Strong educational foundation and experience – A Master’s Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Finance, Public Administration, or related field or the ability to obtain within three years. A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in public finance administration or related fields, preferably in a government setting. A minimum of five years of managerial experience coordinating a range of activities undertaken by others that involve directing, monitoring, and evaluating staff performance. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification preferred. The Village of Schaumburg offers a competitive hiring range of $194,964 to $212,868, with the potential for existing experienced public sector financial professionals to be hired up to the current salary range maximum of $230,773. This position is also provided with a comprehensive, competitive benefits package with coverage that begins on the first day of employment, including health, dental, vision, and life insurance, medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts, and a defined pension through the Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund. View more information about benefits and the salary range on the Village’s website. This position offers flexibility for life events where remote work can be utilized. review_candidates.title: Director Research & Industry Linkages (ALAM - based in Melaka)
review_candidates.description: JOB PURPOSE: Lead the development of governance and execution of research and industry links/partners management. Lead the research and industry links/partners engagement, strategic partnerships, collaboration strategies, to strengthen MMASB/ALAM’s relationships with selected partners, enhance institutional relevance and support long-term business growth and sustainability. Drive strategic partnerships, research & commercial collaborations (including fundings) and stakeholder engagement initiatives that create opportunities for industry-driven research, translating industry needs into practical research initiatives, knowledge creation and value-added solutions. Lead and facilitate industry-oriented research and collaboration by identifying emerging maritime and related industry trends, research priorities and innovation opportunities, fostering collaboration among industry partners, academic institutions and research bodies to strengthen ALAM’s research capabilities and industry contribution. Promote industry connectivity, market intelligence, research collaboration and knowledge exchange to support institutional sustainability, graduate employability, workforce readiness and organisational competitiveness. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES: Develop and implement the governance for research and industry links/partners management. Develop and implement industry engagement strategies, partnership frameworks, research collaborations and joint initiatives to strengthen MMASB/ALAM’s industry presence, reputation and long-term strategic positioning. Establish, strengthen and manage strategic relationships with industry partners, professional bodies, government agencies, maritime organisations and research institutions to create mutually beneficial collaboration and research opportunities. Lead collaborative initiatives with industry stakeholders to facilitate workforce development, professional training, consultancy projects, applied research and industry-led programmes that generate stakeholder value and support organisational growth. Monitor industry trends, workforce requirements, market developments and emerging maritime technologies to identify research priorities, inform programme development, uncover partnership opportunities and support evidence-based institutional decision-making. Establish and coordinate industry advisory mechanisms, research networks and stakeholder engagement platforms to strengthen industry relevance, facilitate knowledge exchange and drive continuous improvement in institutional offerings and research outcomes. Collaborate with industry partners to expand internship, industrial attachment, cadetship and talent development opportunities, while identifying opportunities (including funding) for industry-based research, innovation and knowledge transfer to enhance student employability and workforce readiness. Lead engagement with corporate clients, maritime operators, industry sponsors and strategic stakeholders to secure collaborative research opportunities, industry sponsorships and long-term partnerships that strengthen institutional capabilities and sustainability. Promote and facilitate applied research, joint research projects and knowledge-sharing initiatives with industry, academia and relevant research institutions to address maritime industry challenges, support innovation and translate research findings into practical industry solutions. Represent MMASB/ALAM in industry forums, professional engagements, research networks and networking platforms to strengthen institutional visibility, reputation and influence within the maritime ecosystem. Contribute to institutional transformation initiatives, strategic projects, research development and organisational development efforts to advance MMASB/ALAM’s long-term aspirations, research capabilities and sustainability agenda. REQUIREMENT & QUALIFICATION: Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in industry engagement, business development, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder management or commercial relationship management. Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership position managing external relations, industry collaboration, partnership development, business development or equivalent functions. Experience in the maritime, energy, logistics, transportation, professional training or higher education sectors is an added advantage. Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Maritime Management, International Business, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Economics, Public Relations or a related discipline recognised by the relevant authorities. Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Maritime Management, Strategic Management or a related discipline is an added advantage. Professional maritime certifications, Certificates of Competency (CoC) or industry-recognised professional credentials is an added advantage.

review_candidates.title: Data Migration Specialist
review_candidates.description: JOB DESCRIPTIONS Conduct data migration meeting with client to explain how data migration process will be going Prepare Data Dictionary that have explanation about table structures, data volume, formats, data quality Identify data in scope for migration and data to be excluded (obsolete historical data, duplicates, etc.) Define the reconciliation item agree with the client on what will be reconciled post-migration Extract data from the client's legacy system according to the agreed scope and schedule Coordinate with the client IT team to obtain required data access (database dump, flat file export, API, etc.) Document the extraction method and ensure data integrity during the extraction process. Maintain confidentiality and security of client data throughout extraction Transform data per the Data Mapping Document: format conversion, reference code alignment, value normalization, and so forth Cleanse data of duplicates, inconsistencies, invalid null values, and other anomalies Prepare and execute validation scripts to verify completeness, accuracy, and consistency of migrated data Prepare a production migration plan (rundown migration): step sequence, time estimates, and rollback procedures Execute data migration to the production environment in line with the go-live schedule set by the Project Manager Perform post-migration checks to confirm production data is healthy before go-live operations begin Resolve data migration issue REQUIREMENTS Min. S1 in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics Engineering, or related field Proficient in SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation Experienced working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or equivalent) Able to read and produce technical data documentation (Data Mapping, Data Dictionary, ERD) Familiarity with ETL tools (SSIS or equivalent) is a plus Basic scripting ability (Python or Shell Script) for migration process automation is a plus. Understanding of multifinance business processes: debtor data structures, instalment, collateral, and accounting entries is a plus Familiarity with OJK reporting requirements for multifinance (SLIK, monthly OJK reports) is a plus Detail oriented and structured Strong analytical problem solving skill Able to communicate technical finding clearly to non technical stakeholder Maintains integrity and confidentiality in handling client data Willing to travel and work on site at client location Willing to work in weekend or after office hour according to project schedule

review_candidates.title: Data Analyst
review_candidates.description: 2️⃣ Two roles available! Permanent and 12-month fixed term 📍 Based at East Maitland with hybrid working arrangements after training 🎓 Graduates welcome Start your data career with purpose At Pacific Smiles Group, we open our dental centres every day for one reason: to improve the oral health of all Australians to world's best. Behind that sits a data platform that more than 120 dental centres depend on. Finance, Payroll, People & Culture, Marketing, Clinical Support and Practice teams all use it every day. We're growing our IT Data Engineering team and have two Data Analyst roles available: One permanent, full-time role One 12-month fixed-term role - full time hours You can start now or in January 2027, so if you're finishing your studies this year, we'd love to hear from you! About the role These are hands-on roles in a small, collaborative team that reports to the Data Office Manager. You'll help keep our data, reporting and integrations running smoothly. You'll also be part of a major modernisation project, moving us from a traditional data warehouse to a modern lakehouse on Microsoft Fabric. Day to day, you'll: Monitor daily data pipelines and refreshes, and fix issues when they come up Help business users with reporting questions, data discrepancies and access requests Build and improve Power BI reports and semantic models Develop and test data transformations across our lakehouse layers Help migrate legacy warehouse objects and reports, checking data quality as you go Use Git, CI/CD and AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday work, with every change peer reviewed Write documentation and runbooks so knowledge is shared across the team Every piece of work starts with understanding the business problem, so you'll learn how data creates value, not just how to move it. About you We're looking for curious, motivated people with 0-2 years' experience . Recent graduates in data, IT, computer science, business analytics, maths or a related field are encouraged to apply. You'll bring: SQL skills, from study, projects or work (joins, aggregations, window functions) Some exposure to a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau An understanding of data modelling concepts like fact and dimension tables A methodical approach to troubleshooting and checking data Clear communication, including explaining data issues to non-technical people A genuine interest in learning, and openness to feedback and peer review Respect for data privacy and confidentiality Experience with Python or PySpark, Microsoft Fabric or Databricks, Git, AI coding assistants, or a certification like PL-300 or DP-600 is a bonus, but not essential. We'll help you build these skills. Are we what you're looking for? Pacific Smiles is a rapidly growing professional company. We have 2000+ staff who work together with passion, positivity and a desire to be the best. At Pacific Smiles Group, employees are recognised and rewarded for their contributions, and there is a strong emphasis on career and professional development. We also provide: Workplace flexibility to support life balance, including hybrid working once your training period is complete, and a supportive leadership team dedicated to a culture of excellence An ongoing commitment to training and development, including structured onboarding with an experienced engineering team A corporate health and wellness program An exciting reward and recognition program Extra perks that make a great office environment, like fruit baskets and morning teas (any excuse for cake will do here!) Ready to apply? Submit your application by 16th November or ASAP!
